authorisation: Maintainer requests review of every Incident against new Human Dignity Preservation and, separately, substantive Ecological Values Preservation revision.
method: Read all 194 Incident titles and summaries, screen their recorded occurrence content, and run a broad textual candidate screen across all 1,104 material source clauses. Examine candidate factual bases and material source wording individually. Apply recognition conditions, success conditions and exclusions; keyword matches are search leads, not conclusions.

Reopen material candidate sources: Garcia court opinion, relevant published affected-person reporting, Common Sense Media Grok and ChatGPT for Teens assessments, AIID Torres report and DPD reporting. Existing archived Gemini wording and context remain the decisive source basis for INC-043.
Evaluate ecology across the entire corpus, including unreferenced Incidents. Distinguish topic words, effects and architecture from AI ecological decisions and evidence of actual value consideration.
This is a dated bounded review audit, not a new canonical coverage matrix or permanent completion-status subsystem. Original sources were reopened selectively, not exhaustively for every Incident.

No new legal/compliance outcome, HIM reassessment, taxonomy release, external-source admission or FC-to-requirement relationship is asserted. Existing independent external assessments remain unchanged; newly revised class-to-requirement relationships require source-faithful separate review.
